name: ply
description: Zero-dependency git smart-HTTP client: blobless partial fetch, streamed single-file edit, thin delta push. OTLP spans built in.

scripts.test: node --test test/props.test.js test/oracle.test.js test/concurrency.test.js test/edges.test.js test/adversarial.test.js test/compliance.test.js test/parity.test.js test/push.test.js test/packcache.test.js test/pure.test.js test/bundle.test.js test/sign.test.js test/merge.test.js test/linemerge.test.js test/rebase.test.js test/sshgit.test.js test/protocol.test.js test/workerd.test.js test/read.test.js test/artifacts-compat.test.js test/worker.test.js && node test/fuzz/run.mjs --n 60 && node test/fuzz/hostile.mjs --n 60 && node test/fuzz/liar.mjs --n 60 && node test/fuzz/protocol.mjs --n 100 && node test/fuzz/packs.mjs --n 40 && node test/fuzz/packgen.mjs --n 60 && node test/fuzz/codec.mjs --n 20000 && node test/fuzz/usergiven.mjs && node test/fuzz/attributes.mjs --n 40 && node test/fuzz/linemerge.mjs --n 300 && node test/fuzz/linemerge.mjs --n 200 --runs && node test/fuzz/linemerge.mjs --n 150 --driver union && node test/fuzz/diffscript.mjs --n 60 && node test/fuzz/diffscript.mjs --n 4 --huge
scripts.fuzz:long: node test/fuzz/run.mjs --n 1000 && node test/fuzz/hostile.mjs --n 1000 && node test/fuzz/liar.mjs --n 1000 && node test/fuzz/protocol.mjs --n 1000 && node test/fuzz/packgen.mjs --n 500 && node test/fuzz/codec.mjs --n 300000 && node test/fuzz/linemerge.mjs --n 20000 && node test/fuzz/linemerge.mjs --n 5000 --runs && node test/fuzz/diffscript.mjs --n 1000 && node test/fuzz/diffscript.mjs --n 200 --snake && node test/fuzz/diffscript.mjs --n 50 --huge
scripts.coverage: rm -rf /tmp/ply-cov && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node --test test/props.test.js test/oracle.test.js test/concurrency.test.js test/edges.test.js test/adversarial.test.js test/compliance.test.js test/packcache.test.js test/pure.test.js test/sign.test.js test/merge.test.js test/linemerge.test.js test/rebase.test.js test/sshgit.test.js && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node test/fuzz/run.mjs --n 60 --seed 11 && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node test/fuzz/hostile.mjs --n 60 --seed 12 && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node test/fuzz/protocol.mjs --n 80 --seed 32 && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node test/fuzz/packs.mjs --n 30 --seed 5; NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node test/fuzz/linemerge.mjs --n 200 --runs && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node test/fuzz/linemerge.mjs --n 200 --rediff undecided && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node test/fuzz/diffscript.mjs --n 40 --snake && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node test/fuzz/diffscript.mjs --n 3 --huge && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node test/fuzz/attributes.mjs --n 40 && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node test/fuzz/linemerge.mjs --n 200 --driver union && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=/tmp/ply-cov node test/fuzz/linemerge.mjs --n 50 --driver binary; node test/coverage.mjs /tmp/ply-cov --lines
